{{Otheruses|Chief of Staff}}
The '''Chief of Staff''' served as a filter and buffer between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]] and the [[Supreme Allied Commanders]]. The Chief of Staff prioritized information and problems for the Commander-in-Chief's attention, decided which issues needed her attention, and which could be handled at a lower level of authority. The Chief of Staff was also authorized to act in both the Commander-in-Chief or [[Minister of War (Alliance)/Legends|Minister of War's]] name if both individuals were unavailable.
